newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down, Jly dips below 1250 support.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down, Jly dips below 1250 support.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jly (3rd pos) 1,245 rgt/tonne May (south) 1,330
Open/Hi/Low 1,248/1,252/1,243 Prev close 1,340
Prev settlement 1,254 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Long liquidation in spot month, coupled with a weak soyoil and technical selling continue to pull down prices in all traded contracts. Trading remained volatile with more selling emerging after July dipped below 1,250. Next support for July will be 1,220.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Selling by refiners was seen and market was bearish ahead of a crop report by Ivan Wong on Wednesday.
"Sentiment was further depressed by a weak soyoil," a trader said. Soyoil fell after USDA left its estimate for ending soybean stocks unchanged at 125 million bushels.
"A spate of long liquidation forced spot month May futures to a low of 1,275 ringgit and the weak sentiment spilled over to other contracts," a trader said.
The May futures contract ended at its day's low of 1,275, down 20 ringgit from Monday.
The general weak market sentiment also sparked technical selling and third month July futures dipped below the 1,250 support level.
"The next support level at 1,220," a technical analyst said.
At the close, the July futures contract ended nine ringgit to 1,245 ringgit ($495.03) a tonne.
Traders said some players also liquidated their positions because of the poor fundamentals.

"People are keenly awaiting the release of key April crop data later this week," a trader said. Malaysian private forecaster, Ivan Wong, will release his April crop data on Wednesday before Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) release April export/stocks/output data on May 15.
Physicals saw more refiners selling with interest scattered among nearby CPOS and selected oils.
May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,330 vs bids of 1,325 after trading at 1,325. May (central) saw offers at 1,305 vs bids 1,295.
June (south) was offered at 1,315 vs bids at 1,307.50.
June (central) saw offers at 1,295 versus bids at 1,285.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $552.50, June at $545, July at $540 and July/Aug/Sept at $537.50.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $592.50, June at $582.50, July at $575 and July/Aug/Sept at $567.50.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $422.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $277.50.
